title: Three more text models
summary:
Three text models joined the API, JSON-mode handling got more attention, and a community dashboard found its way into the project list.

Added Scaleway-backed generation for `qwen-coder` (Qwen 2.5 Coder 32B), `mistral` (Mistral Nemo) and `llama` (Llama 3.3 70B). `llama` joined the text model list, while `llamalight` was removed.

The new model integrations support JSON mode. Text generators now return full completion objects, with response handling, streaming and caching updated around them. The JavaScript documentation was also adjusted to describe `jsonMode` as optional.

The Polli API Dashboard was added to the homepage project listings and README. It shows real-time statistics and analytics from the text feed.

highlights.title: Qwen Coder joins text
highlights.text: Generate text with `qwen-coder`, backed by Qwen 2.5 Coder 32B. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=qwen-coder).

highlights.title: Mistral Nemo joins text
highlights.text: Use `mistral` for text generation with Mistral Nemo. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=mistral).

highlights.title: Llama 3.3 joins text
highlights.text: Use `llama` for text generation with Llama 3.3 70B. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=llama).

highlights.title: JSON mode for new models
highlights.text: Request JSON responses from the newly added `qwen-coder`, `mistral` and `llama` integrations. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
